pr_body:
closes #990

This PR adds `gh alias delete <alias>`. It's pretty straightforward.

```
$ gh alias delete foo
✓ Deleted alias foo; was issue list
```

Part of #936
See also #989

issue_context.title: gh alias delete
issue_context.body:
`gh alias delete` lets you delete an alias by name.

Part of #936
